name: Cargo
description: Cargo is a go-to-market automation platform that stores CRM and account data in models, segments it, and runs AI tools, plays and agents for enrichment, scoring and routing.

events.d: Create a record in a selected Cargo model with its column values.
Run a Cargo tool with input data and get its run ID, status and results.
Update the column values of a record in a selected Cargo model.
Get the status, executions and errors of a tool run by its run ID.
Get one record from a selected Cargo model by its record ID.
List records from a selected Cargo model with sorting and pagination.
Permanently delete a record from a Cargo model by its record ID.
Runs when a run of a chosen tool finishes, optionally filtered by run status.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
